description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmploymentStatusDao class within the OrangeHRM system. It contains multiple test methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities related to employment statuses.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing CRUD and search operations of EmploymentStatusDao in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data from a YAML fixture before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusesList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of all employment statuses.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Tests fetching an employment status by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests deletion of employment statuses by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests searching employment statuses with default search filter parameters.

methods.name: testSearchEmploymentStatusWithLimit
methods.description: Tests searching employment statuses with a limit parameter set on the search filter.

methods.name: testSaveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests creating a new employment status.

methods.name: testEditEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employment status.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentStatuses
methods.description: Repeated test for retrieving employment statuses, similar to 'testGetEmploymentStatusesList'.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Tests counting employment statuses based on search filter parameters.
